title: Moroccan Mechoui Beef Tagine
description: A hearty and flavorful slow-cooked beef stew originating from Morocco. This dish is perfect for special occasions and serves a crowd.
instructions: Heat the oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic, cumin, cinnamon, paprika, salt, and pepper. Cook for 1 minute.
Add the beef and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the beef broth and bring to a boil. Cover the pot and transfer to the oven.
Braise the meat for 2 1/2 to 3 hours, or until tender.
Remove the pot from the oven and stir in the chopped parsley.
Serve the mechoui hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
